name: Photo picker
description: Lets the user choose a photo with the system PhotosPicker (no library permission needed) and loads it as an image with loading and error states.
usage: Use `PhotoPickerField(title:image:)` with a `@State var image: UIImage?` binding for a single photo (avatar, item photo). It shows the picker, a loading state and errors. To store the photo, keep the JPEG data from `image.jpegData(compressionQuality:)` in the model (SwiftData `@Attribute(.externalStorage)`).
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify photos-picker` on a Mac with Xcode.
